patch.new_block:
else:
                for b in binders:
                    # R03 repair proposal (worker-004 W004-F1-R03-REPAIR-01):
                    # a binder may be a composite tuple such as "(q,t0)"; require
                    # every identifier component to occur in the formal sentence
                    # as a whole word instead of requiring the literal tuple token.
                    # Power control: any genuinely absent component (or an extra
                    # component absent from formal) is still reported.
                    _toks = [t for t in re.split(r"[^0-9A-Za-z_]+", str(b)) if t]
                    _missing = [t for t in _toks if not re.search(
                        r"(?<![0-9A-Za-z_])" + re.escape(t) + r"(?![0-9A-Za-z_])", formal)]
                    if _missing:
                        bad.append(f"binder {b!r} absent from formal sentence (missing {_missing})")
